workflows.name: REVIEW
workflows.prompt: Review the current diff and recent commits. Report issues by severity without modifying files.

workflows.name: DEBUG
workflows.prompt: Find the root cause of the most recent failure. Explain it, then propose a minimal fix.

workflows.name: REFACTOR
workflows.prompt: Refactor the code touched most recently for clarity without changing behavior.

workflows.name: TESTS
workflows.prompt: Run the test suite, fix any failing tests, and report what changed.
